scope: Lil's Muramasa viewing, tomato boom, and Julio Erneco recruitment scenes.

records.english: {SPEAKER:0C}Admiral, you've found Muramasa! Could you show it to me?{PAD}
records.speaker: Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki
records.context: Yukihisa sees the recovered Muramasa for the first time.
records.source_meaning: Admiral, I hear you've finally found the demon sword Muramasa. I'd like to see it myself.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Of course! Your report led us right to it, Yukihisa.{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Yukihisa sees the recovered Muramasa for the first time.
records.source_meaning: Of course. We were able to find it thanks to Yukihisa's report.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki
records.context: Yukihisa sees the recovered Muramasa for the first time.
records.source_meaning: This... this is the demon sword Muramasa...
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:0C}Hmm... That eerie glow could draw you right in.{PAD}
records.speaker: Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki
records.context: Yukihisa sees the recovered Muramasa for the first time.
records.source_meaning: Hmm... it gives off a strange glow that seems to draw one in.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki
records.context: Yukihisa sees the recovered Muramasa for the first time.
records.source_meaning: It was a feast for the eyes.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: A-amazing...
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Fernando
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Whoa! It's a huge hit!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferrog
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Ah, tomato sauce! Wow, that looks delicious!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Fernando
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Look at that woman! Even the pattern on her clothes...
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:09}Never thought it'd be such a hit!{PAD}
records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: I never thought it would become this popular!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Of course it did. Yours truly started it!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Of course it would! I'm the one who produced it, after all!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Fernando
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: What are you talking about? Your mouth was hanging open in surprise.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: No way! W-was it?
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: {MACRO:FI}, you look happy.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Of course! Everyone's having fun thanks to us!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Heh, of course. Our efforts made the people of this town so happy!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Look at everyone's faces. They're all smiling.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}The shops make money, and so do we! What's not to love?{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: The shopkeepers earn money, and I make a fortune too. Nothing could make me happier!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: {MACRO:FI}, this work really suits you.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Yes. I'm truly glad I went to sea.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}More smiles for everyone, more profit for {MACRO:FO}!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: I want to see more people enjoying themselves, and {MACRO:FO} must make more money too!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Fernando
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: How reassuring! Where will you start the next craze, and what will it be?
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Fernando, you're getting quite enthusiastic too.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:14}You don't get to gamble on this scale even in a casino!{PAD}
records.speaker: Fernando
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Even a casino rarely offers the thrill of a gamble on this scale.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:0E}Bananas next! Or pumpkins! My mouth's watering already!{PAD}
records.speaker: Emilio Ferrog
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Let's make bananas the next trend! Or pumpkins! Just thinking about it makes me hungry!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Honestly, anything edible will do for you.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Let's report back to the guild here!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Let's go report to this town's guild.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil's tomato promotion becomes a townwide craze; the crew celebrates and reports to the guild.
records.source_meaning: Let's go report to this town's guild.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Can't a man get a decent drink?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Won't someone let me have a good drink?
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: For a man of the sea, nothing is harder than being unable to have a good drink.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: What's that man muttering to himself about?
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Kamil, look at that old man. All he does is complain.{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Kamil, look at that older man. He's been complaining this whole time.
records.localization_note: Old man is familiar address, not a claim that Julio is Lil's grandfather.

records.english: {SPEAKER:09}Well, people do get cranky as they age. Happens to us all.{PAD}
records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: People tend to grumble when they get old. Anyone could end up like that.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Not me! My figure won't change, and my mind will stay sharp!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Not me! My figure won't change, and my mind won't grow dull either.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Did you just say that I've grown senile?!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Whoa! Sorry, sir. Come on, {MACRO:FI}, apologize too.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Why? He just heard me wrong!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: I did not hear wrong! I'm still an active navigator!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Oh, you were a navigator? Hope you live long!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Oh, you were a navigator, old man? I hope you live long.
records.localization_note: Lil's patronizing wish keeps the joke without inventing a family relationship.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Ah! There goes {MACRO:FI} again...
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}What did you say?! You little brat! Young people have no respect!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: What?! You contrary little thing! Young people these days have no respect!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}Hey, you're talking to an admiral. Need something, 'former' navigator?{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Even so, I'm an admiral! Does this former active navigator need something?
records.localization_note: Quotation marks make Lil's teasing emphasis on former explicit.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: I can't watch this anymore...
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: What! You're an admiral? Then it's decided. I'll join your ship.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: I won't be satisfied until I teach you personally!
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Wait a moment... how did it come to this?
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Show me to your ship.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:09}({MACRO:FI} might calm down a little.) Let's take him aboard.{PAD}
records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: (Maybe {MACRO:FI} will calm down a little.) Let's give in and take him with us.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: Oh, fine! I suppose we have no choice.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: That's right. You should listen to a veteran.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: I'm Julio Erneco. Pleased to meet you.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}All right. Let's see you prove you're still active.{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil and Kamil meet the gruff navigator Julio Erneco and bring him aboard.
records.source_meaning: All right. But you'll have to prove you're still active.
records.localization_note: Source meaning and the neighboring scene lines reviewed for natural American English.
